title: Information-Time Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.24380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RLVR has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, existing methods typically parameterize temporal progression in the Markov Decision Process by token-by-token generation, despite the highly non-uniform information flow along autoregressive trajectories. In this paper, we propose InfoPPO, which reparameterizes temporal progression using information density rather than raw token count. This reparameterization induces a common state-dependent structure for both temporal credit propagation and policy updates. InfoPPO restores the effectiveness of non-trivial discounting in long-horizon reasoning, retaining effective-horizon contraction while avoiding excessive attenuation of terminal supervision over long token sequences. Moreover, the information-time policy-improvement analysis naturally leads to a state-dependent update constraint, which we implement through adaptive clipping. By adapting the clipping threshold

translated_title: 信息时间近端策略优化
translated_abstract: RLVR（可验证奖励的强化学习）已大幅提升了大语言模型的推理能力。然而，现有方法通常通过逐token生成的方式在马尔可夫决策过程中参数化时间进程，尽管自回归轨迹上的信息流高度不均匀。本文提出InfoPPO，它使用信息密度而非原始token数量来重新参数化时间进程。这种重新参数化为时间信用传播和策略更新引入了一种共同的状态依赖结构。InfoPPO恢复了非平凡折扣在长程推理中的有效性，在保留有效视界收缩的同时，避免了长token序列上终端监督信号的过度衰减。此外，信息时间策略改进分析自然地引出了一个状态依赖的更新约束，我们通过自适应裁剪来实现该约束。通过自适应调整裁剪阈值……
tldr: InfoPPO提出用信息密度而非token数量来重新参数化强化学习中的时间进程，并通过状态依赖的自适应裁剪约束，恢复了折扣机制在长程推理中的有效性，从而提升大语言模型推理能力。
en_tdlr: InfoPPO reparameterizes temporal progression in RL using information density rather than token count, restoring effective discounting for long-horizon reasoning and introducing state-dependent adaptive clipping to improve LLM reasoning.
